title: ABCDE eyed3 Error
body: Good afternoon, Whenever I try to rip a CD with title names that are in foreign letters or have an apostrophe, I get gibberish text. I have tried changing ID3TAGV in abcde.conf to both id3v2.3 and id3v2.4, and I get similar errors. Below is what I get after I rip a CD and the tagging process begins while using id3v2.3. eyed3:ERROR: Traceback (most recent call last): File "/usr/lib/python3.13/site-packages/eyed3/id3/__init__.py", line 129, in __init__ self.id = id ^^^^^^^ File "/usr/lib/python3.13/site-packages/eyed3/id3/__init__.py", line 164, in id raise ValueError(f"Unknown genre ID: {val}") ValueError: Unknown genre ID: 255 The above exception was the direct cause of the following exception: Traceback (most recent call last): File "/usr/lib/python3.13/site-packages/eyed3/main.py", line 277, in _main retval = mainFunc(args, config) File "/usr/lib/python3.13/site-packages/eyed3/main.py", line 41, in main eyed3.utils.walk(args.plugin, p, excludes=args.excludes, fs_encoding=args.fs_encoding, ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ recursive=recursive) ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/usr/lib/python3.13/site-packages/eyed3/utils/__init__.py", line 71, in walk handler.handleFile(os.path.abspath(path)) ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/usr/lib/python3.13/site-packages/eyed3/plugins/classic.py", line 475, in handleFile self.printTag(self.audio_file.tag) ~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/usr/lib/python3.13/site-packages/eyed3/plugins/classic.py", line 588, in printTag genre = tag.genre if not self.args.non_std_genres else tag.non_std_genre ^^^^^^^^^ File "/usr/lib/python3.13/site-packages/eyed3/id3/tag.py", line 706, in _getGenre return Genre.parse(f[0].text, id3_std=id3_std) ~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/usr/lib/python3.13/site-packages/eyed3/id3/__init__.py", line 219, in parse return Genre(id=int(strip0Padding(g_str))) File "/usr/lib/python3.13/site-packages/eyed3/id3/__init__.py", line 137, in __init__ raise GenreException from ex eyed3.id3.GenreException Has anyone experienced this issue before? What does the error mean? Thanks in advance.
